question: In a certain code language, S is written as 8, A is written as 26 and E is written as 22. How will STORAGE be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/094413ca23e189e59a3d82079258703e8647a6aa49a3c37196c6d31304d23587.png] 

The logic followed here is:-

 
• S is written as 8, A is written as 26, and E is written as 22, which means the place value of the opposite letter.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/359fde14f889b428f1f23f952db1994df36c9c6babb00a254324fabe0f946c89.png]
